description: Count received messages matching the same search and filters as list_messages.

before.description: Exclusive receipt/submission time: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, optional 1–3 fractional digits, then Z or ±HH:mm.

from.description: Exact email address in From, case-insensitive; not the SMTP envelope sender.

labels_all.description: Require every listed label. Filter groups combine with AND; empty arrays impose no condition.

items.description: Case-sensitive label, trimmed; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

labels_any.description: Require at least one listed label.

items.description: Case-sensitive label, trimmed; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

labels_none.description: Exclude messages with any listed label.

items.description: Case-sensitive label, trimmed; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

query.description: Match all words or quoted phrases in subject/body. Case-insensitive keyword search, not semantic similarity; up to 16 terms/phrases.

recipient.description: Exact email address in To/Cc/Bcc where available, case-insensitive.

subject.description: Literal case-insensitive substring of the subject.
